_comment: Chef-curated names for the V3 HDBSCAN-UMAP clusters. Keyed by cluster_id (stable at seed=42, HDBSCAN min_cluster_size=40, method=leaf, reassign_noise=true, on the imputed embedding). Labels target the DOMINANT INGREDIENT CONTENT of each cluster — not the auto-generated chemistry tag, which captures volatile-compound overlap but mixes cooking categories.
_disclaimer: Chemistry clusters don't map cleanly to chef categories. Many ingredients land in chemistry-coherent but cooking-diverse clusters (e.g. butter-cream sweets share lactonic chemistry with creamed soups). The chemistry_label field on each cluster preserves the auto-generated descriptor for debugging. When refining, sample 20+ members and pick a label that covers ≥60% of the cluster — accept that 40% will be outliers.

0.notes: Asian sauces (fish, chili paste, oyster), sausages (andouille, kielbasa), coconut products, brown sugar / apple butter / sweet condiments. Waxy-ether chemistry from lipid + aromatic compounds across these. ~157 members.

1.notes: Baking ingredients (bread roll, rice flour, dough, raisin bread, sweet potato), warm spices (cardamom, cinnamon, allspice, fennel, saffron), flavored alcohols (brandy, whiskey, schnapps), some dairy. Phenolic + anisic chemistry binds them. Note: REAL HERBS (thyme/oregano/parsley/dill) land here too, but they're a minority of the cluster — don't call this 'Herbs & Spices.' ~681 members.

2.notes: Meats (beef, lamb, chicken), cheeses, baking mixes, beer, savory cooked foundations. Mustard-savory-cultured chemistry. This is the mega-cluster at 1,107 members (33% of corpus) — the 'cooking foundation' bucket.

3.notes: Dairy (evaporated milk, half-and-half, cottage cheese, cream cheese), cooked grains (rye bread, pasta, navy bean), some Asian condiments (sesame oil, tamari, garam masala). Almost NO alliums despite the briny-oriental chemistry tag. ~619 members.

4.notes: Sweets (butterscotch, mascarpone, raspberry jam), sauces (BBQ, orange, tamari, sherry vinegar), fruits (lingonberry, grape juice, candied pineapple), some spices (chipotle, crab boil). Pulpy-floral chemistry. ~826 members.
